Our Service

Our Service

Led by EL GHAZALI SARA, Friday Movie Night is a weekly event for international students held every Friday at 18:30 in Building 6 Smart Classroom. Each week features a different film, creating a fun and relaxing way to end the week with fellow students. Students can vote for upcoming movies and suggest films they would like to watch in the future. Whether you love drama, comedy, or adventure, there is something for everyone. Join us every Friday and enjoy great movies together!

What to Expect

What to Expect

01

Weekly Screenings

Weekly movie screenings every Friday at 18:30 in Building 6 Smart Classroom. A different film each week for international students to enjoy together.

02

Student Voting

Student voting on upcoming movies. Have your say in what gets screened next and shape the weekly movie lineup for the group.

03

Suggest a Movie

Movie suggestions welcome! Recommend films you love or have always wanted to watch. Your picks could be the next Friday feature.

04

Unwind Together

A fun and relaxing way to spend Friday evening with fellow international students. Unwind, connect, and enjoy great cinema together.
